title: Cain and Abel
lines: Adam and Eve had two sons named Cain and Abel.
亞當和夏娃有兩個兒子，名叫該隱和亞伯。
When Cain and Abel grew up, Cain became a farmer, while Abel became a shepherd.
當該隱和亞伯長大後，該隱成了一個農夫，而亞伯成了一個牧羊人。
When it was time for the harvest, Cain and Abel both brought gifts to God.
到了收割的時候，該隱和亞伯都帶了禮物獻給神。
Cain gathered some of the things he had grown and gave them to God.
該隱收集了一些他種植的農作物，把它們獻給神。
God wasn't pleased with Cain and his offering, and this made Cain upset.
神不喜悅該隱和他的供物，這讓該隱很不高興。
God asked, "Why are you so angry? Do what is right, and then you will be accepted."
神問：「你為什麼這樣生氣呢？你若行得好，就必蒙悅納。」
God told Cain to be careful not to let sin control him, but instead to take control of sin.
神告訴該隱要小心，不要讓罪控制他，而是要去制伏罪。
Abel also gave a gift to God.
亞伯也帶了禮物獻給神。
Abel gave God the best part of his firstborn sheep from his flock.
亞伯將他羊群中頭生的羊，把最好的部分獻給神。
God was very pleased with Abel and his offering because he had given the best of what he had.
神非常喜悅亞伯和他的供物，因為他獻上了自己最好的。
